_what_this_is: A DAMAGE RECORD, not an exception list. Each entry states a known, measured,
permanent hole in the RECORDED store, with enough detail that anyone can
re-derive it from the public archive without trusting this file.
It is consulted by exactly one assertion: COMPLETENESS (archive \ recorded).
It is NEVER consulted for FIDELITY. If the collector invents a print, or
disagrees with the venue on any field of any print it did record, the gate
goes red and this file offers no way out. Completeness may carry a labelled
The completeness assertion matches the EXACT SET of missing ids against the
id_ranges below. A single print of new loss fails the gate. This file cannot
be used to wave through damage it does not already name to the print.
Every field in _required_fields is enforced by test_damage_record_is_a_record
so this cannot decay into a bare list of dates.

entries.utc_hour_profile: 100% in UTC 00-07 (off hours). 0% in UTC 16-22 (NY session, the best-coverage window). 70.6 min of tape = 4.91% of the day.
entries.cause: aggTrades cursor reset on leg restart. _aggtrades_loop initialised `cursor: Optional[int] = None` per call (collector.py:2744 @ 57ad311), so a leg restart inside a live process resumed at the LIVE EDGE and silently dropped the backlog accumulated during the outage. The `cursor is not None` guard at :2754 suppressed the id-gap alarm that would have announced it. Attribution rests on the shape: all four holes are perfectly CONTIGUOUS id blocks, which is what jump-to-live-edge produces and what packet loss or a venue outage does not.
entries.introduced_by: 57ad311 (binancef: the aggressive layer, over REST because the WS topic is filtered)
entries.condition: Four leg restarts on 2026-08-03 while the collector process itself stayed up (PID 14595, running since Mon 03:00). Host Maintenance Sleep is the leading candidate for the restarts themselves (reports/incident-2026-08-04-sleep/baseline.md), but that experiment was deferred and the link is NOT established.
entries.fixed_by: UNCOMMITTED as of 2026-08-04 — module-scope _AGGTRADES_CURSOR survives leg restarts, _AGGTRADES_SEEK_BACK_MAX = 50000 bounds the catch-up with a LOGGED skip count, and the id-gap alarm now fires where the guard suppressed it. The largest hole here is 11,462 prints = 22.9% of that ceiling, so the fix would have recovered ALL FOUR blocks with no loss. Not yet active: the collector has not been restarted.
entries.recoverable_from: data/vision/binancef/BTCUSDT/aggTrades/date=2026-08-03/ — the prints exist in the archive under their own source label. They are NOT backfilled into `trades`. Gaps stay gaps (scripts/check_ticks.py:12-16); a second labelled source is not a repair.
entries.measured_how: tests/test_vision_overlap.py against a fresh ingest of the published archive day, set difference in both directions. Fidelity on the 999,497 rows the collector DID record: ts_ms mismatch 0, max|dprice| 0.0, max|dqty| 0.0, side mismatch 0. UTC hour attribution computed with explicit floor division in Python after two SQL attempts silently disagreed (DuckDB rendered strftime in the session zone Asia/Jakarta, then CAST(x AS BIGINT) rounded instead of truncating); the three methods were compared and only the floor-division result is recorded here.
